705530101.text: Ha! So Hertha's even roped our Honorary Knight into helping with this little venture?

705530102.text: When we were discussing the drinks stand earlier, I took one look at the menu and could barely contain my excitement. Now it's finally time to sample the finished products.

705530103.text: I just had a couple of drinks at the plaza not long ago, but when it comes to fine wine, I'm a sucker for more... Ahem, as long as it stays within healthy limits, of course!

705530104.text: Now that I'm finally free to relax, it's time to start doing just that!

705530107.text: Can't wait to see your skills in action! Give me something that goes well with casual conversation, but still packs a punch...

705530301.text: Here you go, Grand Master, a cocktail just for you! I guarantee you won't find this one too polite!

705530302.text: Such a spirited drink... How did you make this? That burning scent of Fire-Water... It's as if the very air were about to ignite! This is more like it!

705530304.text: Perfection! It's clear that once you let go of your inhibitions, your talents really shine through!

705530305.text: That first hit of Mint is like a cooling feint that masks the Fire-Water underneath.

705530306.text: By the time the sweetness dissipates, the Fire-Water has already slipped in behind your guard, ready to deliver a powerful strike of intense flavor. It's exactly the impact I was hoping for!

705530309.text: That's the most ingenious part! Fire-Water's greatest flaw is a lack of aftertaste, but the Smetana perfectly maintains the flavor at the peak of its intensity!

705530201.text: Grand Master, I hereby present you with this Thorny Lake for your enjoyment and assessment!

705530202.text: Well, the color and aroma are certainly on point, but as for the balance of flavors... I'll just have to taste it and find out.

705530203.text: Not bad, you haven't overdone or skimped on any single ingredient... Though unfortunately, it's a little too "polite" for my tastes.

705530206.text: Perhaps I should have said "modest"? You've followed the formula to a tee — but if anything, you've played it a little too safe.

705530207.text: Were you worried that deviating just a little might disappoint me?
